newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Cable to raise capital to 500 mln riyals.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Cable to raise capital to 500 mln riyals.

text.p: Saudi Cable Company said on Tuesday it would raise its capital to 500 million riyals ($133.3 million) from 300 million riyals in two phases.
A company statement said in a first phase it would offer one million new shares worth 100 riyals each to its shareholders who had signed up for the new issue. It did not give the date for the issue.
In a second phase it would issue bonus shares of the same value worth another 100 million riyals which would be distributed to shareholders on a one-to-four basis.

Traded on the Saudi stock market, the company posted 5.3 million riyals in net profit in the first quarter of 1997. The company said in March it received permission from the Saudi commerce ministry for the increase in its paid-in capital. ($1 = 3.75 riyals)
